page.layout: One column of running text, with a centred heading "Partitio." in the middle of the page. Each paragraph opens with an italic run-in phrase. Running head at the top with page number 309 at its right. Signature "u 3" at the foot, beside the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: de non obstare quod Meuius dicebat, isto modo usuras ex pacto debitum i-ri. nō enim ex pacto, sed ex stipulatio-ne per pactum renouata, & reforma-ta, deberi. Altera ratio est, quia usura creditae pecuniae deberi, nisi post moram, non potest. Titius autem moram non uniuersae fortis, sed primae tantum penfionis admiserat.
main_text.head: Partitio.
main_text.p: Tunc eo amplius.) Enunciatio I. Apud Romanos ex usurarum stipulatione ius dicebatur. Rationem in libello de Usuris exposuimus. quoniam creditoris interest, usu carere suae pecuniae.
Pacta incontinenti.) Sequitur I 1. Pacta continenter adiecta stipulationi-bus, uim ex iis, quasi in ipsis insita, ad pariendam actionem sumunt. L. pertens, 27.C.de pact.
Perinde esse ac si.) Seq. III. Pactum de forte, continenter adiectum stipulationi fortis & usurarum, etiam in usuras valet.

page.notes: Running head is hard to read; the reading "PANDECT. LECT." is a guess. The enumerator "I 1." after "Sequitur" is uncertain. The word "deben-" at the line end is read from a broken word; the joining syllable is unclear. A small mark stands at the right near the heading "Partitio." and was not transcribed as text. The printed spelling "Meuius" is kept as printed.
